data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 8.3m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2017: GBP 10.1m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2017: predominantly from the nuclear property class).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate released GBP 8.3m of prior-year technical reserves in 2018 (a release of roughly 17.7% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 46.84m). The report attributes the improvement predominantly to favourable claims development in the nuclear property class. No quantified per-line allocations or specific named catastrophe events are provided against this prior-year release.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a GBP 8.3m release; assumed to be a GROSS figure as presented in the movement note. No per-line monetary split available; the note attributes the release to the 'nuclear property class' but does not quantify by LOB. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 28) but was not fully transcribed here; triangle could be used for cross-checking if needed.
